narrative.overview: A clean, warm, professional page built on a visibly drawn grid — and on every screen, exactly one element refuses to fit. That misfit is always the thing that acts, and it alone carries color. The site performs the company's positioning on itself: CodeFuse takes the problems that don't fit, so the thing that doesn't fit is the thing you click. Signature interaction: hovering a misfit straightens it — we make it fit.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper ground with faintly drawn column rules; calm near-black type
Cobalt reserved exclusively for misfit actions; quiet breaks stay ink and positional
One misfit per screen — the rhythm is order, order, break
No fabricated proof; Work renders only when real case studies exist

rules.name: The Misfit Rule
rules.body: Cobalt appears only on elements that both break the grid and perform an action. A colored element that fits, or a broken element that isn't actionable, is a violation. Quiet breaks are ink and positional only.

dos: Do keep exactly one break per screen; a new section earns its break by carrying the action.
Do keep every claim true today; Work renders only when a case-study file exists.
Do keep the email reachable from the first viewport with prefilled subject and a copy affordance.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion: plates settled at their tilt, no entrance choreography.
donts: Don't let Cobalt touch anything that fits the grid or anything that isn't an action.
Don't add a second accent, gradients, glass, blur shadows, or icon-card grids.
Don't tilt more than 2 degrees or break the grid twice on one screen.
Don't carry over grammar from the Catalog or fuse-line worlds.
